question:
In namespace `lighthouse`, the Deployment `lamp-driver` (2 replicas) sets the environment variable `LAMP_ROTATION` from key `rotation` of the ConfigMap `lamp-config`. Operations wants the lamp to rotate faster.

1. Change the value of key `rotation` in ConfigMap `lamp-config` to `fast`. Leave the other keys of the ConfigMap unchanged.
2. Make sure the running Pods of `lamp-driver` actually use the new value. The Deployment must keep reading `LAMP_ROTATION` from the ConfigMap key (do not hard-code the value) and must end up with 2 ready, up-to-date replicas.
3. Annotate the ConfigMap `lamp-config` with `harbor-logistics.io/change-ticket=HL-4471`.

verification.description: ConfigMap lamp-config has rotation=fast and color unchanged
lamp-driver still reads LAMP_ROTATION from the ConfigMap, 2 ready replicas, and every running Pod has LAMP_ROTATION=fast
